{"metadata":{"description":"English · 简体中文","id":"gh:1342966420","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-visualizer","slug":"Moses14159/dsh-visualizer","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"# dsh-visualizer"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"**English** · 简体中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> An external plugin that **does not modify DSH source**: lets the model **render visuals on the fly"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"** in the conversation — streaming SVG/HTML widgets and structured charts (ChartSpec → echarts)."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## What is this"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Inside a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) conversation, let the model **produce visual content directly** and "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"render it safely into the chat:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Structured charts** — the `spec` of the `visualize` tool, rendered with echarts (line / bar / ar"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ea / pie / scatter).
- **SVG / HTML widgets** — the model writes ```svg / ```html fences that render"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" **token-by-token, streaming** into a sandboxed iframe; it can also deliver a complete widget via th"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"e `widget` parameter of `visualize`."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"It reuses DSH's **existing** `assistant/chunk` and `tool/call` + `tool/result` events, and **does no"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"t change DSH source**."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Two kinds of output, three delivery paths**: `visualize(spec)` for charts; ```svg / ```html fenc"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"es in the message body for **streaming** widgets; `visualize(widget)` for a complete widget.
- **Str"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"eaming render**: reuses the existing `assistant/chunk` events to get token-by-token output, so the w"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"idget **updates frame by frame** as the text streams.
- **Two-sided validation**: host `execute` and"},{"id":"p9s5","text":" the client fold share **the same pure-function parsers** (`chartspec` / `widget`), so model drift c"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"annot silently pass through.
- **Security isolation**: widget code is inserted **verbatim** into a `"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"sandbox=""` iframe + CSP `default-src 'none'`; there is no sanitizer to bypass.
- **Rendering experi"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"ence**: charts sample the `--dsw-alias-*` tokens; SVG widgets size to their intrinsic aspect ratio; "},{"id":"p9s9","text":"cards carry a "fit / 1.5× / 2×" zoom and a status badge (generating / truncated / done).
- **Gracefu"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"l degradation**: any validation or render failure leaves no blank row and throws no error — it falls"},{"id":"p9s11","text":" back to a plain code block or a JSON card.
- **Pure, testable**: the core logic is all DSH-free pur"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"e modules — 97 unit tests run standalone in Node."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Preview"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**Real conversation screenshots** (rendered inside the DSH Web client):"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Structured chart · visualize(spec) → echarts (follows the DSH theme)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Widget · visualize(widget) → sandboxed iframe"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**More render samples** (rendered by the plugin's own code):"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Left: bar chart · Right: SVG widget · Bottom-left: HTML widget · Bottom-right: streaming render (```"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"svg fence updated token by token)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Install directly from GitHub (recommended — the built artifacts are committed):"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Alternatively, clone it and install from the local path:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Why this shape works (source-level facts)"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- `assistant/chunk` is an **existing** session event family: the agent-loop logs each `StreamChunk` "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"as `{ turn, step, chunk }`, and the web client's streaming text is exactly a fold of these events — "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"the plugin reuses the same stream to obtain token-by-token output, **without adding a new host-side "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"event family**.
- `conversationEvents` is a cordis `Service` an external plugin can inject; `visuali"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"zer-widget` folds the same batch of `assistant/chunk` events **in parallel** with the built-in `assi"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"stant-step`, without interference.
- `conversation.chat.node` is a keyed slot (`replaceRisk: 'none'`"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"); registering a string key — `{ key: 'visualizer-chart' | 'visualizer-widget' }` — is an additive c"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"ontribution.
- `ChatNodeViewProps` / `ConversationNodeDefinition` / `ChatNodeDataMap` are all **pure"},{"id":"p24s9","text":" types**, erased at build time, so they don't trip the client bundle's purity gate.
- **Determinism*"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"*: `match` reads only the current event; every event of one Context carries or independently derives"},{"id":"p24s11","text":" the same stable id (`step:<turn>:<step>` / `widget:<callId>`); `update` folds one Match per log `se"},{"id":"p24s12","text":"q`, so it is **replayable**."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Security boundary"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Layer | Handling |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Model → spec / widget | host `execute` validates with `parseChartSpec` / `parseWidgetSpec`; invali"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"d payloads are rejected (the tool errors) |
| Text stream → widget | the client `WidgetScanner` only"},{"id":"p27s3","text":" recognizes line-leading ```svg / ```html fences; widget code is **not markup-validated** (any byte "},{"id":"p27s4","text":"can be a legal prefix while streaming), so the security boundary lives at the render side |
| sessio"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"n log → client | the Definition's `update`/`fallback` **re-parses** the result text; the full `assis"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"tant/message` is the cold-replay recovery source |
| Render (widget) | two layers of isolation: ifra"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"me `sandbox=""` (no scripts / same-origin / forms / popups / navigation, opaque origin) + an injecte"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"d CSP `default-src 'none'` in the srcdoc; code is inserted **verbatim**, so there is no sanitizer to"},{"id":"p27s9","text":" bypass |
| Render (chart) | ChartSpec is pure data → echarts `setOption`; no HTML/SVG injection sur"},{"id":"p27s10","text":"s |
| Render (chart) | ChartSpec is pure data → echarts `setOption`; no HTML/SVG injection surface |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Any validation or render failure **degrades** (the node isn't rendered / the fence stays a plain cod"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"e block / a JSON card) — never a blank row or a thrown error in the chat."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **Charts still appear "whole"**: ChartSpec is delivered via a tool call, so there is no token-by-t"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"oken streaming chart (tool arguments aren't streamable); the fence widgets are the streaming path.
-"},{"id":"p30s3","text":" **The fence source and the widget card coexist**: the code block the model writes still renders as "},{"id":"p30s4","text":"a normal markdown code block (as the "source" view), while the widget card renders in the stream — t"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"hey are not mutually exclusive.
- **Widgets are static**: the sandbox disables scripts, so interacti"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"ve components (button logic, animated scripts) won't run; use a chart or a purely presentational wid"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"get when you need interaction.
- **No mermaid**: v1 supports only svg/html fences; render mermaid di"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"agrams as plain code blocks or in a later version.
- **Fences must be at line start** (≤ 3 spaces of"},{"id":"p30s9","text":" indent); an inline ```svg is not a fence, and a lone ``` line inside the content closes the fence ("},{"id":"p30s10","text":"CommonMark semantics).
- echarts is lazily `import('echarts')` and inlined into the client bundle (t"},{"id":"p30s11","text":"he registry route serves a single file, so it can't be code-split yet)."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **Node**: `>= 20`; **DSH**: loaded through the external-plugin mechanism (profile bundle patch).
-"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" **peer dependencies**: `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"client-ui-conversation`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `react`, `react-dom`."}],"truncated":true}
